summary: Brookfield Asset Management filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, attaching a press release welcoming a new U.S.–Korea strategic framework agreement. The framework commits up to $120 billion of Korean investment to finance eight U.S. nuclear reactors — six Westinghouse AP1000 units across three two-unit plants on federal sites plus two APR1400 reactors — and includes a cornerstone Korean equity investment of 5%–10% in Westinghouse. Brookfield is not an acquirer here; it endorses the framework alongside its existing Westinghouse partnership with the U.S. Government and Cameco.
